{
  "pros": [
    "Simple and intuitive interface, easy to get started with core features.",
    "Efficient task management with quick adding, assigning, and due dates.",
    "Streamlined communication and file sharing within projects.",
    "Clear project organization with dedicated tools for different aspects.",
    "Focus on essential project management without overwhelming complexity.",
    "Good for teams who prefer a less feature-heavy, distraction-free environment."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited functionality compared to competitors, lacking advanced features like approvals or detailed reporting.",
    "The free plan is very restrictive, limiting users to a single project.",
    "Initial project setup requires manually adding tools one by one, which can be tedious.",
    "Lack of integrated overview for tasks and events across all projects or a central calendar.",
    "Some UI quirks like unexpected renaming behavior or dynamic form element shifts.",
    "May not be suitable for complex workflows requiring extensive customization or integrations."
  ],
  "overall_rating": 4.0
}
